test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 30 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The following bar graph shows the production of cement (in 10,000 tones) by 4 companies X, Y, Z and W during the period 2018 - 2020. Study the bar graph carefully and answer the question.

Which company has the maximum average production over the course of 3 years?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fbcb550f45747a3cc43413f10e5adde7b2f5863b4822143b42d2d7be0f743d55.png]
solution:
**Given:**

We are provided with the updated production data of cement (in 10,000 tons) for four companies (X, Y, Z, and W) over the years 2018, 2019, and 2020.

Production of cement in 2018, 2019, and 2020 for each company:

Company X: 5.2 (2018), 8 (2019), 8.1 (2020)

Company Y: 6.5 (2018), 6.6 (2019), 7.6 (2020)

Company Z: 7 (2018), 7.2 (2019), 6.2 (2020)

Company W: 6.8 (2018), 6.9 (2019), 7 (2020)

**Calculation:**

The average production for each company over the 3 years.<
